Competitor X's strategy of aggressive price cutting combined with increased digital marketing aimed at younger demographics poses a significant threat to our market share and sales figures. By absorbing short-term losses to build long-term loyalty, they are attempting to lock in customers and shift consumer perceptions. This dual approach of undercutting prices and targeting a specific demographic could erode our customer base and necessitate a strategic response to retain relevance and profitability.

The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.
